links.outcome: AI performance reported separately by acquisition device (Topcon vs ZEISS cameras)
links.effect: On ZEISS images: accuracy 90.6%, specificity 92.3%, sensitivity 83.3%, lower sensitivity than Topcon images; overall sensitivity 97.1%, specificity 94.8%.
links.quote: LuxIA validation on ZEISS-obtained images demonstrated high accuracy (90.6%), specificity (92.3%) and lower sensitivity (83.3%) as compared with Topcon-obtained images.

screen.reason: Multicenter external validation of an AI algorithm (LuxIA) for diabetic retinopathy screening on clinical datasets across different camera hardware, evaluating diagnostic accuracy.
